policy.reviewer: Codex chemistry analyst; name/structure consistency review, not supplier or experimental verification
policy.default_scope: Names and submitted SMILES read together; retain explicit precursor structures, preserve all hypotheses and unknown reaction compatibility

c1ccc(SSc2ccccc2)cc1.reason: Symmetric diphenyl disulfide; equivalent sulfur atoms retained as the source hypothesis, one reagent identity.

OB(O)c1ccncc1.reason: Submitted structure has the ring nitrogen para to the boronic acid position; original name said pyridin-3-yl. Preserve structure and correct display name; do not silently move the boron position.

C=C[Si](C)(C)C.display_name: 乙烯基三甲基硅烷结构／烯丙基名称冲突
C=C[Si](C)(C)C.reason: Submitted structure lacks the allylic CH2 required by both original name and allylic-transfer rationale. Quarantine rather than inventing a corrected reactive structure or changing the claimed mechanism.

CS(=O)[O-].[Na+].reason: One S=O and one anionic O identify methanesulfinate, not methanesulfonate; original label mixed the two names.

[Na+].[O-]O.reason: The explicit submitted structure is sodium hydroperoxide, not sodium peroxide. Formulation, stability and operational compatibility remain unverified.

CCOC(=S)[S-].[K+].reason: Same reagent proposed at two sulfur sites; keep both atom-specific hypotheses but one reagent identity.

CSSc1ccccc1.reason: Mixed disulfide is one reagent; retain separate methylthio and phenylthio transfer hypotheses without duplicate molecule count.

C=C(C)[O-].[Li+].display_name: 丙酮烯醇锂（显式离子形式）
C=C(C)[O-].[Li+].reason: Keep O- and C-bonding hypotheses for the same enolate precursor; aggregation and actual reactive state are not established by this structure.

policy.screening_safety_note: Air-sensitive organometallics, reactive phosphines, diazonium, azide and peroxide reagents require separate trained-laboratory risk review; do not use the generated blank templates as dosing instructions.
